description: This is a test class file for the EmployeeMembershipAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests for various API endpoints related to employee membership management, including getOne, getAll, create, update, and delete operations, along with validation rules. The class extends EndpointTestCase and uses mocking to simulate dependencies and external services.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipAPITest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the EmployeeMembershipAPI class, testing CRUD operations and validation rules for employee membership management.
